hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; }; pgrep -f 'http.server 8123' >/dev/null || (nohup python3 -m http.server 8123 >/tmp/audit-http.log 2>&1 &); echo '[session-start] audit environment ready: npm run audit'
